en: So this was a key module. We learned a lot
of important things.
We learned about convenience features with
Denon, which automatically restarts our
server, and about import maps, which aren't
fully supported by Visual Studio Code and
the Denon extension right now,
but which can be very useful nonetheless.
But we also had an extensive look at
debugging, at finding and fixing errors, and
different techniques you can use for that.
We learned about try-catch for unavoidable
errors.
I mentioned that you should follow the
official style guide and that you should use
TypeScript.
I showed you what you should do if your IDE
is showing an error to you.
And you also learned how to debug your
applications step by step with the
inspect-brk flag.
And with that, you got all the necessary
tools to advance and to build more amazing
Deno applications. Speaking of that, it's
now time to leave the world of dummy
applications and progress towards a real web
app.
